name: Pidilite Industries Ltd
about: Pidilite Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of adhesives and sealants, construction chemicals, craftsmen products, DIY  products and polymer emulsions in India. Most of the products have been developed through strong in-house R&D. Our brand name Fevicol has become synonymous with adhesives to millions in India and is ranked amongst the most trusted brands in the country. Some of our other major brands are M-Seal, Fevikwik, Fevistik, Roff, Dr. Fixit, Fevicryl, Motomax, Hobby Ideas, Araldite. [1]
keyPoints:
Revenue Breakup
Company earns about 53% of its revenues from adhesives & sealants category, followed by Construction & paint chemicals (20%), industrial resins & construction chemicals (7%), art & craft materials (6%), industrial adhesives (6%), and pigment & preparation (6%).. 
It has its business divided into 2 divisions, consumer & bazaar products which account for ~80% of revenues, and B2B products segment which accounts for ~20% of revenues [1] In total,the company produces ~6500 products for its brands. [2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 46.6%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 25.8 days to 18.7 days
cons: Stock is trading at 15.6 times its book value
